lessons.name: Beshgacha sanaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola 1 dan 5 gacha to'g'ri sanaydi, oxirgi son nechtaligini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Salom, bolajonlar! Men — Kabutar qushcha. Sonlar mamlakatida katta bayram! Lekin avval eski do'stlarimiz — birdan beshgacha sonlarni chaqiramiz. Tayyormisiz?

items.image_prompt: Numbers one to five holding hands in a row, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sonlar navbat bilan turadi: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh. Barmoqlarni bittadan ochib, birga sanaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A finger touching chicks one by one, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sanaganda har bir jo'jaga bir marta tegamiz. Birini ham tashlab ketmaymiz, ikki marta ham sanamaymiz.

items.image_prompt: Four chicks with a big number four above them, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bir, ikki, uch, to'rt. Oxirgi son — to'rt. Demak, jo'jalar to'rtta! Oxirgi son doim nechtaligini aytadi.

tests.why: Barakalla! Bir, ikki, uch, to'rt — to'rtta.

extra.matn: Bir, ikki — qo'l ko'taring! Uch, to'rt — qarsak chaling! Besh — sakrab, qo'l siltang! Yana boshidan, bolajon!
extra.sodda: Beshgacha sanab, besh marta qarsak chaling.

lessons.name: Son va rasm
lessons.goal: Bola raqamni taniydi va unga mos miqdorni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men sonlarga xat yozdim, lekin konvertlar aralashib ketdi. Har bir songa mos rasmni topib berasizmi?

items.image_prompt: A big number three drawn on a card, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu belgi — uch raqami. Raqam sonni yozib ko'rsatadi. Uchni ko'rsak, uchta narsani o'ylaymiz.

items.image_prompt: Number five card next to five stars, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Besh raqamiga beshta yulduz mos keladi. Sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh. Mos keldi!

lessons.name: Oldingi va keyingi son
lessons.goal: Bola 1–5 ichida sonning oldingi va keyingi qo'shnisini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Sonlar uyida har bir sonning ikki qo'shnisi bor: biri oldida, biri keyinida. Kim kimning qo'shnisi ekan?

items.image_prompt: Number three with an arrow to number four, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uchdan keyin to'rt keladi. Keyingi son har doim bittaga ko'p. Uchta olmaga bitta qo'shsak — to'rtta.

items.image_prompt: Number two with an arrow from number three, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uchdan oldin ikki turadi. Oldingi son bittaga kam. Uchta olmadan bittasini olsak — ikkita.

extra.matn: Men son aytaman, siz keyingisini aytib sakraysiz! Ikki — … uch! To'rt — … besh! Endi oldingisini ayting: uch — … ikki!
extra.boshqa_usul: Zinada turib: keyingi son — bir pog'ona yuqoriga, oldingi — pastga.

lessons.name: Olti soni
lessons.goal: Bola olti sonini taniydi, oltitagacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Beshdan keyin kim keladi? Sonlar mamlakatiga yangi mehmon keldi — u beshdan bittaga ko'p. Kutib olamiz!

items.image_prompt: A friendly number six character, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — olti soni. Beshtaga yana bitta qo'shsak — olti bo'ladi. Bir qo'lda besh barmoq, ikkinchisidan bitta: olti!

items.image_prompt: Six colorful donuts in a row, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Pishiriqlarni sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh, olti. Oltita pishiriq!

items.image_prompt: A cute ant showing its six legs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Chumolini ko'ring. Uning oyoqlarini sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh, olti. Chumoli oltita oyoqda yuradi!

lessons.name: Yetti va sakkiz
lessons.goal: Bola yetti va sakkiz sonlarini taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Yomg'irdan keyin osmonda kamalak chiqdi. Uning ranglarini sanaymizmi? Keyin dengizdagi do'stimizning oyoqlarini ham sanaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A friendly number seven character, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — yetti soni. Oltiga bitta qo'shsak — yetti. Kamalakning yettita rangi bor, haftada yetti kun bor.

items.image_prompt: A bright rainbow with seven colors, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kamalak ranglarini sanaymiz: qizil, to'q sariq, sariq, yashil, havorang, ko'k, binafsha. Yettita!

items.image_prompt: A friendly octopus next to number eight, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — sakkiz soni. Yettiga bitta qo'shsak — sakkiz. Sakkizoyoqning sakkizta oyog'i bor!

extra.matn: Qizil, to'q sariq, sariq, yashil, havorang, ko'k va binafsha — yettita rang, kamalak bo'ldi! Har rangda bitta barmoq oching!

lessons.name: To'qqiz va o'n
lessons.goal: Bola to'qqiz va o'n sonlarini taniydi, o'n barmoqni sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men bir sir aytaman: sizning ikki qo'lingizda katta son yashiringan. Barcha barmoqlarni sanasak, qaysi son chiqadi?

items.image_prompt: A friendly number nine character, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — to'qqiz soni. Sakkizga bitta qo'shsak — to'qqiz. To'qqiz barmoq ko'rsating: bitta barmoq bukilib qoldi!

items.image_prompt: A friendly number ten character, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — o'n soni. To'qqizga bitta qo'shsak — o'n! O'n — bir va nol bilan yoziladi.

items.image_prompt: Two open hands showing ten fingers, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikki qo'lni oching. Bir qo'lda besh, ikkinchisida besh. Hammasi — o'n barmoq!

lessons.name: O'ngacha sanaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola 1 dan 10 gacha va teskari sanaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Raketa uchishga tayyor! Lekin u faqat o'ndan birgacha teskari sanasak uchadi. Avval oldinga sanashni mashq qilamiz!

items.image_prompt: Numbers one to ten standing on a long staircase, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh, olti, yetti, sakkiz, to'qqiz, o'n! Har qadamda son bittaga ko'payadi.

items.image_prompt: A rocket ready to launch with a countdown, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi orqaga sanaymiz: o'n, to'qqiz, sakkiz, yetti, olti, besh, to'rt, uch, ikki, bir — uch! Raketa uchdi!

extra.matn: Cho'kkalab o'tiring. O'ndan birgacha birga sanaymiz: o'n, to'qqiz, sakkiz… bir! Uchdik — baland sakrang!
extra.boshqa_usul: O'nta qadam tashlab sanang, keyin orqaga qaytib teskari sanang.

lessons.name: Ko'proq va kamroq
lessons.goal: Bola juftlab solishtirib, qaysi guruh ko'p, qaysi kam ekanini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qushlar ovqatga kelishdi, men donlarni teraman. Hamma qushga don yetarmikan? Keling, juftlab ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: Four birds and three grains, one bird left without grain, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Har qushga bitta don qo'yamiz. Bitta qushga yetmadi — qushlar ko'proq! Ortib qolgan tomon — ko'proq.

items.image_prompt: Three grains of wheat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Donlar yetmadi — donlar kamroq. To'rtta qush, uchta don. Uch to'rtdan kam.

lessons.name: Teng
lessons.goal: Bola ikki guruh tengligini juftlab tekshiradi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bog'chada har bolaga bitta stul kerak. Stullar yetadimi? Ortib qolmaydimi? Keling, tekshiramiz!

items.image_prompt: Three children and three small chairs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Har bolaga bitta stul. Hammaga yetdi, ortiqcha ham qolmadi. Bolalar va stullar teng!

items.image_prompt: Bees lined up above flowers, one bee per flower, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Arilarni bir qatorga, gullarni ostiga qo'yamiz. Har ari tagida bitta gul. Juft chiqdi — teng!

extra.matn: Oilangiz a'zolariga bittadan likopcha qo'ying. Endi har likopchaga bitta qoshiq. Likopcha va qoshiq tengmi? Ko'pmi, kammi?
extra.sodda: Ikkita likopcha va ikkita qoshiq bilan boshlang.
extra.boshqa_usul: O'yinchoqlarga bittadan qalpoqcha yoki kubik bering.

lessons.name: Sanab solishtiramiz
lessons.goal: Bola sanab, katta son ko'proq, kichik son kamroq ekanini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Juftlash uzoq davom etsa-chi? Sirli usul bor: sanaymiz! Qaysi son katta bo'lsa, o'sha ko'p. Sinab ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: Five balloons next to three balloons, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Beshta shar va uchta shar. Besh sanoqda uchdan keyin keladi. Demak, besh ko'proq!

items.image_prompt: Two apples next to six apples, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikkita olma va oltita olma. Ikki oltidan oldin keladi. Demak, ikki kamroq.

tests.q: Kimda qalam ko'p: Alida 6 ta, Zeboda 9 ta?

lessons.name: Teng qilamiz
lessons.goal: Bola bittasini qo'shib yoki olib guruhlarni tenglaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ikki sincap yong'oq bo'lishdi. Birida ko'p, birida kam — xafa bo'lishdi! Ularni yarashtirib, teng qilamizmi?

items.image_prompt: Two squirrels, one gets an extra acorn to make them equal, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Birinchi sincapda uchta, ikkinchisida ikkita yong'oq. Ikkinchisiga bitta qo'shamiz — ikkalasida uchta. Teng!

items.image_prompt: A squirrel putting away one extra acorn, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yoki ko'pidan bittasini olib qo'yamiz: ikki va ikki. Bu ham teng! Tenglashning ikki yo'li bor.

extra.matn: Ikki o'yinchoq oling. Biriga uchta, biriga bitta kubik bering. Xafa bo'lishdi! Endi teng qiling — qanday qildingiz?
extra.boshqa_usul: Konfet yoki mevalarni oilangiz bilan teng bo'lishing.

lessons.name: Birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi
lessons.goal: Bola navbatda birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchini aytadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Hayvonlar yugurish musobaqasiga chiqdi! Kim birinchi keladi? Kim ikkinchi? Keling, marra yonida kutamiz!

items.image_prompt: A gold medal on a ribbon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Quyon marraga hammadan oldin yetdi. U — birinchi! Birinchi — eng oldingi.

items.image_prompt: A silver medal on a ribbon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Quyondan keyin tulki keldi. Tulki — ikkinchi. Ikkinchi birinchining orqasida turadi.

items.image_prompt: A bronze medal on a ribbon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Keyin toshbaqa keldi. Toshbaqa — uchinchi. Birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi!

extra.matn: Uch o'yinchoqni qatorga qo'ying. Birinchisini ko'rsating! Ikkinchisini! Uchinchisini! Endi almashtiring — kim birinchi bo'ldi?
extra.boshqa_usul: Oila bilan navbatga turing va kim nechanchi ekanini ayting.

lessons.name: To'rtinchi va beshinchi
lessons.goal: Bola beshinchigacha tartib sanaydi, oxirgisini topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Poyezdda beshta vagon bor. Mushukcha qaysi vagonda? Tartib bilan sanasak, topamiz!

items.image_prompt: A train wagon with number four on it, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi, to'rtinchi! To'rtinchi vagonda mushukcha o'tiribdi.

items.image_prompt: A train wagon with number five on it, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'rtinchidan keyin beshinchi keladi. Beshinchi vagonda kuchukcha bor.

items.image_prompt: A small flag at the end of a line, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Beshinchi vagondan keyin vagon yo'q. U — oxirgi. Oxirgi — eng orqadagi.

lessons.name: O'ng va chap
lessons.goal: Bola o'ng va chap qo'lini, o'ngda va chapda joylashuvini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qo'llarimiz egizak, lekin ismi har xil! Bittasi o'ng, bittasi chap. Bugun ularni hech qachon adashtirmaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A child raising the right hand to say hello, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Salomlashganda o'ng qo'limizni beramiz. Ko'pchilik qoshiqni ham o'ng qo'lda ushlaydi. O'ng qo'lni ko'taring!

items.image_prompt: A child raising the left hand, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikkinchi qo'limiz — chap. Yuragimiz ham chap tomonda uradi. Chap qo'lni ko'kragingizga qo'ying!

items.image_prompt: A pear on the left and an apple on the right of a child, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Olma o'ng qo'lim tomonida — olma o'ngda. Nok chap qo'lim tomonida — nok chapda.

extra.matn: O'ng qo'l — oldinga, o'ng qo'l — orqaga! Chap qo'l — oldinga, chap qo'l — orqaga! Aylanib, qarsak chalamiz!
extra.boshqa_usul: O'ng oyoq bilan sakrang, keyin chap oyoq bilan.

lessons.name: Chapdan boshlab sanaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola qatorni chapdan o'ngga tartib bilan sanaydi, nechanchi va nechtani farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kitobni qaysi tomondan boshlab o'qiymiz? Chapdan! Qatordagi narsalarni ham chapdan sanaymiz. Keling, sinab ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: A row of chicks with an arrow from left to right, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qatorni chap tomondan boshlaymiz: birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi… O'ngga qarab boramiz.

items.image_prompt: Four chicks in a row, the third one looks different, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Jo'jalar nechta? To'rtta! Kichik jo'ja nechanchi? Chapdan sanaymiz: birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi. U — uchinchi!

lessons.name: To'rtburchak
lessons.goal: Bola to'rtburchakni taniydi va kvadratdan farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kvadratning bir qarindoshi bor. Uning ham to'rtta burchagi bor, lekin u cho'zinchoq! Kim ekan? Eshikka qarang!

items.image_prompt: A simple rectangular wooden door, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Eshik — to'rtburchak. Burchaklarini sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt. Ikkita tomoni uzun, ikkitasi qisqa.

items.image_prompt: A square next to a rectangle, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kvadratning hamma tomoni bir xil. To'rtburchak esa cho'zinchoq: bir tomoni uzun, bir tomoni qisqa.

items.image_prompt: A phone and a book, both rectangular, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kitob, telefon, deraza, stol usti — hammasi to'rtburchak. Uyingizda yana qaysi to'rtburchakni topasiz?

tests.q: Qaysi shaklning hamma tomoni bir xil?

extra.matn: Uyingizni aylanib, to'rtburchak narsalarni toping: eshik, deraza, kitob… Nechtasini topdingiz? Barmoq bilan sanang!
extra.boshqa_usul: Qog'ozga to'rtburchak chizib, uni eshikka aylantiring.

lessons.name: Oval
lessons.goal: Bola ovalni taniydi va doiradan farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening uyamda bir narsa bor. U doiraga o'xshaydi, lekin cho'zinchoq. Nima ekan? Tuxum! Uning shakli — oval.

items.image_prompt: A white egg showing an oval shape, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tuxumga qarang. U dumaloq, burchagi yo'q, lekin cho'zinchoq. Bu shakl — oval.

items.image_prompt: A circle next to an oval, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Doira hamma tomondan bir xil dumaloq. Oval esa cho'zilgan doiraga o'xshaydi. Ikkalasida ham burchak yo'q.

items.image_prompt: A rugby ball and a potato, both oval, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Regbi to'pi, kartoshka, tarvuz — hammasi ovalga o'xshaydi. Qani, yana oval narsani toping!

lessons.name: Uch rangli naqsh
lessons.goal: Bola uch elementli naqshni ko'radi va davom ettiradi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men svetoforga qaradim: qizil, sariq, yashil. Munchoqni ham shunday tersak-chi? Uch rangli naqsh — yangi sir!

items.image_prompt: Beads in a repeating red yellow green pattern, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qizil, sariq, yashil — keyin yana qizil, sariq, yashil. Uchtasi navbat bilan qaytadi. Bu — uch rangli naqsh.

items.image_prompt: A highlighted group of three beads red yellow green, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Naqshda bitta bo'lak qayta-qayta keladi: qizil-sariq-yashil. Bo'lakni topsak, keyingisini oson aytamiz!

extra.matn: Qarsak, tizza, sakrash! Qarsak, tizza, sakrash! Uch harakat — naqsh bo'lagi. Uch marta takrorlaymiz!
extra.boshqa_usul: Ovoz bilan naqsh qiling: mo', miyov, vov!

lessons.name: Shakl naqshi
lessons.goal: Bola shakllardan uch elementli naqsh davom ettiradi, tushib qolganini topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Shakllar qatorga turib, naqsh o'ynashyapti. Lekin bittasi yashirinib oldi! Uni topa olasizmi?

items.image_prompt: Shapes in a row: circle triangle square repeated, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Doira, uchburchak, kvadrat. Yana doira, uchburchak, kvadrat. Shakllar ham naqsh bo'ladi!

items.image_prompt: A shape pattern with one missing spot marked by a question mark, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Doira, uchburchak, bo'sh joy… Keyin yana doira, uchburchak, kvadrat. Demak, bo'sh joyda kvadrat bor edi!

lessons.name: Kattadan kichikka
lessons.goal: Bola 3–4 narsani kattadan kichikka tartiblaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qo'g'irchoq ichidan qo'g'irchoq, uning ichidan yana qo'g'irchoq chiqdi! Ularni qanday qatorga teramiz?

items.image_prompt: The biggest nesting doll in a set, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana eng katta qo'g'irchoq. U hammasidan katta. Qatorda birinchi turadi.

items.image_prompt: The smallest tiny nesting doll, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana eng kichik qo'g'irchoq. U hammasidan kichik, kaftga sig'adi. Qatorda oxirgi turadi.

items.image_prompt: An elephant, a dog and a mouse in a row by size, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Fil, kuchuk, sichqoncha. Eng kattasidan boshlaymiz, har keyingisi kichikroq. Mana, tartib bo'ldi!

extra.matn: Uydagi idishlar yoki qutichalarni oling. Eng kattasini birinchi qo'ying, keyin kichikroqni, keyin eng kichigini. Tartib bo'ldimi?
extra.boshqa_usul: Eng kichigidan boshlab kattasiga qarab tering.

lessons.name: Uzundan qisqaga
lessons.goal: Bola 3–5 narsani uzunligi bo'yicha tartiblaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qalamlarim sochilib ketdi: biri uzun, biri qisqa. Ularni zinapoya qilib tersak, chiroyli bo'ladi. Yordam berasizmi?

items.image_prompt: The longest pencil among several, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qalamlarning boshini tekislaymiz. Eng uzoqqa ketgani — eng uzun. Uni birinchi qo'yamiz.

items.image_prompt: The shortest little pencil stub, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Eng tez tugagan qalam — eng qisqa. U qatorning oxirida turadi.

items.image_prompt: Pencils arranged from longest to shortest like stairs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uzun, qisqaroq, yana qisqaroq, eng qisqa. Qalamlar zinapoyaga o'xshab qoldi!

lessons.name: Beshta minora
lessons.goal: Bola beshta narsani pastdan balandga tartiblaydi, o'rtadagisini topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kubikchalardan beshta minora qurdik. Ularni pastidan balandigacha tersak, zinapoya chiqadi. Sanab ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: Five toy block towers arranged from short to tall, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Eng past minorada bitta kubik, keyingisida ikkita, keyin uchta, to'rtta, beshta. Har biri bittaga baland!

items.image_prompt: Five towers with the middle one highlighted, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Beshta minoraning o'rtasida uchinchisi turadi. Undan chapda ikkita, o'ngda ham ikkita.

tests.q: Minoralar pastdan balandga: 1, 2, 3, 4… keyingisida nechta kubik?

extra.matn: Kubiklardan beshta minora quring: birinchisida bitta, ikkinchisida ikkita… beshinchisida beshta. Zinapoya bo'ldimi? Qo'g'irchoqni zinadan chiqaring!
extra.sodda: Uchta minora quring: bitta, ikkita, uchta.
extra.boshqa_usul: Oila a'zolarini bo'yiga qarab qatorga turg'izing.

lessons.name: Ertalab va kunduzi
lessons.goal: Bola ertalab va kunduzni, ulardagi ishlarni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Xo'roz qichqirdi: qu-qu-qu! Quyosh chiqdi. Men uyg'onib, kerishdim. Kun qanday boshlanadi? Keling, bilib olamiz!

items.image_prompt: Sunrise over hills with a rooster crowing, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ertalab quyosh chiqadi. Biz uyg'onamiz, yuvinamiz, nonushta qilib bog'chaga boramiz.

items.image_prompt: A bright sun high over a playground, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kunduzi quyosh osmonning tepasida. Hamma yoq yorug'. Biz o'ynaymiz, tushlik qilamiz, sayrga chiqamiz.

lessons.name: Kechqurun va tun
lessons.goal: Bola kechqurun va tunni, ulardagi ishlarni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Quyosh botyapti, osmon qip-qizil. Keyin qorong'i tushadi, yulduzlar chiqadi. Bu vaqtlar qanday ataladi?

items.image_prompt: Sunset over a small town with an orange sky, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kechqurun quyosh botadi. Oilamiz uyga yig'iladi, kechki ovqat qilamiz, ertak o'qiymiz.

items.image_prompt: A crescent moon and stars over a sleeping house, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tunda qorong'i bo'ladi, oy va yulduzlar chiqadi. Hamma uxlaydi, kuch yig'adi.

extra.matn: Ertalab quyosh chiqar, kunduzi charaqlar, kechqurun botib ketar, tunda oy chiqar! Har birida harakat qiling!
extra.boshqa_usul: Chiroqni yoqib-o'chirib kun va tunni o'ynang.

lessons.name: Kun tartibi
lessons.goal: Bola kun qismlarini tartib bilan aytadi, avval va keyinni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kun qismlari navbatga turishdi, lekin adashib qolishdi. Kim birinchi, kim oxirgi? Keling, tartibga keltiramiz!

items.image_prompt: Four pictures in a row: sunrise, noon sun, sunset, night moon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Avval ertalab, keyin kunduzi, keyin kechqurun, oxirida tun. Keyin yana ertalab keladi. Kun aylanib turadi!

items.image_prompt: A child eating breakfast then going out with a backpack, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Avval nonushta qilamiz, keyin bog'chaga boramiz. Avval tishni yuvamiz, keyin uxlaymiz. Tartib muhim!

extra.matn: Kuningizni ko'rsating: uyg'onish, nonushta, o'yin, kechki ovqat, uyqu! Oilangiz qaysi vaqt ekanini topsin!
extra.boshqa_usul: Kun rasmlarini qog'ozga chizib, tartib bilan tering.

lessons.name: Qo'shildi — ko'paydi
lessons.goal: Bola «qo'shildi» hikoyasida narsa ko'payishini tushunadi (5 ichida)
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Shoxda ikkita qushcha o'tirgan edi. Keyin yana bittasi uchib keldi — bu men edim! Endi nechta bo'ldik?

items.image_prompt: Two birds on a branch and one more flying in, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikkita qushcha bor edi. Yana bitta qo'shildi. Qo'shilsa — ko'payadi! Endi sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch.

items.image_prompt: Three birds sitting together on a branch, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Eskilari va yangi kelganini birga sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch. Birga uchta qushcha!

extra.matn: Qo'lingizga ikkita kubik oling. Onangiz yana bittasini bersin. Endi nechta? Sanang! Yana birini qo'shing — nechta bo'ldi?
extra.boshqa_usul: Barmoqlar bilan: ikki barmoq, yana bitta — nechta?

lessons.name: Ketdi — kamaydi
lessons.goal: Bola «ketdi» hikoyasida narsa kamayishini tushunadi (5 ichida)
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ko'lda uchta qurbaqa o'tirgan edi. Bittasi sakrab suvga tushib ketdi — shalop! Endi nechtasi qoldi?

items.image_prompt: Three frogs on a log and one jumping into the pond, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uchta qurbaqa bor edi. Bittasi ketdi. Ketsa — kamayadi! Endi qolganlarini sanaymiz.

items.image_prompt: Two frogs sitting on a log, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ketganini sanamaymiz, faqat qolganlarini: bir, ikki. Ikkita qurbaqa qoldi!

tests.q: 🐸🐸🐸 bor edi, bittasi ketdi. Nechta qoldi?
🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈 bor edi, bittasi uchib ketdi. Nechta qoldi?

lessons.name: Hikoyali masalalar
lessons.goal: Bola qisqa hikoyani tinglab, qo'shildi yoki ketdi ekanini aniqlaydi va javobni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men sizga kichkina hikoyalar aytaman. Diqqat bilan tinglang: kimdir keldimi yoki ketdimi? Keyin sanaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A child listening carefully to a story book, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Hikoyada «keldi, berdi, qo'shildi» desa — ko'payadi. «Ketdi, yedi, uchib ketdi» desa — kamayadi. So'zga quloq solamiz!

items.image_prompt: A child counting on fingers, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uchta olma bor edi — uch barmoq ochamiz. Ikkitasini yedik — ikkita barmoqni bukamiz. Bitta qoldi!

tests.q: Alida 2 ta mashina bor edi. Dadasi yana 2 ta berdi. Nechta bo'ldi?
Tarelkada 4 ta pechenye bor edi. Zebo bittasini yedi. Nechta qoldi?
Uyada 5 ta jo'ja bor edi. 2 tasi yugurib ketdi. Nechta qoldi?

extra.matn: O'yinchoqlar bilan hikoya qiling: «Uchta ayiqcha o'ynayotgan edi. Bittasi uyiga ketdi.» Nechta qoldi? Endi siz hikoya o'ylab toping!
extra.boshqa_usul: Oilangizga hikoyali masala aytib bering, ular topsin.

lessons.name: Beshtagacha hisoblaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola 5 ni ikki qismga ajratadi, hammasi ketsa hech narsa qolmasligini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening beshta olmam bor. Ikki savatga solaman. Har xil usulda solsa bo'ladimi? Keling, sinab ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: Five apples split into two baskets, two and three, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Beshta olmani ikki savatga soldik: birida ikkita, birida uchta. Birga sanasak — yana besh! Bir va to'rt ham besh bo'ladi.

items.image_prompt: An empty basket after all apples are taken, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Savatda ikkita olma bor edi. Ikkalasini ham yedik. Hammasi ketdi — savat bo'sh, hech narsa qolmadi!

tests.q: 🍬🍬🍬 bor edi, hammasini yedik. Nima qoldi?
tests.why: Ofarin! Hammasi ketdi — hech narsa qolmadi.

extra.matn: Besh barmoqni oching. Ikkitasini buking — nechta ochiq qoldi? Uchta! Endi hammasini buking — hech narsa qolmadi! Musht bo'ldi!
extra.boshqa_usul: Beshta kubikni ikki qo'lga har xil bo'lib oling va sanang.
